description: Register identifiers for a signed webhook when their verdict changes: phantom -> squat (someone registered a name models invent) or absent -> exists. Use for a name that came back absent/phantom which the user still intends to use, or a dependency set worth monitoring. Requires an API key; costs 25 credits ($0.02) per identifier per 30 days.

callbackUrl.description: Public https URL to POST transitions to.

namespace.description: pkg.npm, pkg.pypi, pkg.crates, pkg.go, pkg.maven (group:artifact), pkg.nuget, pkg.rubygems, pkg.packagist (vendor/name), pkg.hex, pkg.pub, img.docker, repo.github (owner/repo), cite.doi

value.description: Exactly as written, e.g. requests, @types/node, github.com/spf13/cobra, org.slf4j:slf4j-api, 10.1038/nature12373

version.description: Optional exact version to verify. Models invent versions too.

name: hallux_watch
